TRACER-ROUND ARCS — colored tracer-round streaks crossing the sky in arcing lines from anti-air positions below, briefly illuminating the hull-underside in strobing red and gold, each burst-cluster walking toward the engine nacelles in adjustment.

ORBITAL-STRIKE BEAM DESCENT — single focused column of coherent energy descending vertically from above the cloud ceiling onto a distant ground target, the beam-shaft visible as a ruled white line, ground-flash blooming orange through the cloud-break below.

DROPSHIP DEPLOYMENT — smaller assault-craft launching in sequence from chassis-bay doors along the skyship's belly, each dropship trailing its own engine-glow cone, descending in staggered echelon toward the burning city far below.

ATMOSPHERIC-RE-ENTRY BURN STREAK — long re-entry streak crossing the upper sky with white-hot leading edge and widening orange fire-trail, something large descending from orbit fast, burn-trail visible for miles before impact-bloom lights the horizon.

DISTANT FORMATION ENGAGING — wedge-formation of capital-class ships visible at vanishing point trading weapon-flashes with an unseen adversary, smoke-columns rising from fresh kills, the scale of the battle implied entirely by light and rising fire.

DOGFIGHT TANGLE — multiple skyship silhouettes locked in tight pursuit across the upper sky, contrails crisscrossing in hard-bank loops, weapon-flashes strobing between fuselages, one silhouette already trailing smoke in a flat spiral descent.

SONIC-BOOM SHOCKWAVE — visible atmospheric ring expanding outward from a supersonic flyover, air distorting in a translucent pressure-disc, dual vapor-cones collapsing in the ship's wake, the shockwave rippling cloud-deck below into concentric rings.

EXPLOSION-BLOOM AT DISTANCE — bright orange fireball from a destroyed ship visible at deep distance, debris-cloud expanding outward in slow-rolling fragments, the fireball still climbing as secondary explosions pulse through the wreck.

CARRIER-AIRSHIP LOOMING ABOVE — vast carrier-class mothership filling the upper background, its hangar-bays open and illuminated, wave after wave of smaller craft launching from its flight-decks, scale dwarfing the hero skyship passing beneath its keel.

DEBRIS-FIELD FOREGROUND — tumbling wreckage filling the foreground from a recent kill, the hero skyship banking hard through hull-fragments and burning deck-sections, shrapnel sparking off its own shields as debris spins past the canopy.

SEARCHLIGHT BEAMS SWEEPING — multiple ground-based anti-air searchlights sweeping the cloud layer tracking the skyship, beams crossing and recrossing through mist, the hull briefly caught in full white illumination before banking hard into cloud-cover.

LIGHTNING ELECTROMAGNETIC STORM — sky dense with branching electromagnetic arc-discharges jumping between charged cloud-banks, strike-clusters hitting the skyship's antenna-arrays repeatedly, hull briefly outlined in crawling blue current with each discharge.

CONTRAIL TANGLE — multiple ships' contrails crisscrossing the sky in dense dogfight geometry, sun lighting white trails against deep blue, the pattern of loops and hard-break turns narrating the battle in persistent vapor-script across the upper sky.

DEPLOYED SWARM-DRONES — dense swarm of combat drones launching from hangar-bays in coordinated tight formation, engine-trails braiding into a single luminous braid before fanning outward into attack-spread, the swarm darkening the sky beneath the ship.

PLASMA-DISCHARGE FROM HULL — visible plasma-arc bleeding between damaged hull-plates after a direct impact, energy crackling across chassis-seams in branching white threads, the discharge cycling in pulses as the compromised conduit vents uncontrolled into open air.

CITY-BELOW-ON-FIRE — distant city ablaze visible through multiple breaks in the cloud-deck far below, block after block burning, smoke-columns rising and merging into a single dark overcast that glows orange from beneath with continuous ground-fire.

CRASHED-SHIP FIREBALL — fresh impact-crater visible at ground level through a cloud-break directly below, recently-downed capital ship folded into terrain, fuel fires still climbing, secondary explosions rippling through its collapsed superstructure in bright orange pulses.

EMP-PULSE DAMPENED HULL — skyship's running-lights stuttering offline in sequential cascade after an EMP-burst, hull going dark from bow to stern, engine-glow flickering and dimming, the ship briefly a dark silhouette tumbling before emergency systems claw power back.

COMET-LIKE METEOR-STRIKE — incoming kinetic-rod crossing the upper sky with white-hot leading edge and widening fire-trail, contrail glowing visible for miles above, the rod's terminal angle suggesting imminent surface-impact somewhere beyond the burning horizon.

CARRIER-BAY LAUNCH WAVE — carrier-class vessel's entire forward flight-deck igniting simultaneously as a full wing launches in wave-formation, engine-wash visible as a rippling heat-distortion beneath the carrier's keel, the launch-flare briefly outshining the overcast sky.

ANTI-AIR FLAK BURST FIELD — dense black flak-bursts detonating across the sky in staggered altitude-layers, each burst expanding into a dark smoke-ring, the pattern walking closer to the skyship as targeting corrections tighten the bracket around the hull.

CAPITAL-SHIP BROADSIDE EXCHANGE — two capital-class vessels exchanging broadside fire at close range, weapon-flashes lighting both hulls simultaneously, energy-blasts visible as bright projectiles crossing the gap, structural damage blooming on both ships with each landed hit.

BURNING DEBRIS RAIN — streams of burning wreckage descending from a destroyed ship high above, each piece trailing its own fire-contrail downward, the combined fall creating a curtain of descending flame across the sky that the hero skyship must navigate through at speed.

ATMOSPHERIC RE-ENTRY BURN STREAK — white-hot leading edge crossing the upper sky at steep angle, orange-red plasma-sheath bleeding behind it in a widening trail visible for miles, something large descending from orbit toward the active battlefield below.

KILL-SHOT RAIL-BEAM TRAVERSE — solid-slug rail-cannon discharge crossing the full frame in a single frame-wide streak of hypersonic light, the air around the round's path briefly ionized white, a secondary crack-line expanding from the traverse as the round exits frame toward its distant target.

FORMATION OF DISTANT SHIPS — capital-class wedge formation visible at extreme range in tight parade-spacing, weapon-discharge flashes cycling along their broadside batteries in coordinated salvos, the flashes illuminating the hulls at intervals, smoke from previous exchange already smearing the formation's silhouette across the far sky
